content.text:
New invoices are now due on the last day of the month after the month they're issued in, and both tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The fix is all on the server, in `InvoiceService.java`:
- I removed the 30-day payment-terms constant.
- A new `dueDateFor(issued)` method moves the issue date forward one month and returns the last day of that month. So 2026-01-31 gives 2026-02-28, and December gives 31 January of the next year.

I also updated the comment on `newDraft` in the front-end `invoice.service.ts` to describe the new rule.

Invoices that already exist keep the due date they have, and no data or schema changes were needed.
